summary: LocaShare (Getaround clone) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/16 pytest tests pass (93.75%). Only failing endpoint is GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} which returns 500 due to Stripe session retrieval via emergentintegrations proxy. Frontend: Welcome, login (demo@locashare.fr/demo1234), register, Explorer tab with categories+listings, listing detail (with owner, photo, location, price), booking flow with date pickers and Stripe checkout summary all work on mobile viewport 390x844. UI is polished, purple/white theme consistent, French copy correct.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. Stripe session retrieval via emergentintegrations raises CheckoutError('No such checkout.session: cs_test_...') even for session_id just returned by POST /api/checkout/session (same request context). Session created with api_base=https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1 but stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve uses default api_base. This breaks the payment-success polling in frontend. Needs try/except around stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status and ideally use StripeCheckout instance method that preserves api_base. HIGH PRIORITY - blocks payment confirmation flow.

minor.issue: Pricing mismatch: backend computes total_price = days * price_per_day (e.g. 2*89 = 178.00€) and Stripe is charged this amount. UI /booking/[id].tsx displays an additional 10% 'Frais de service' (17.80€) and shows 'Payer 195.80€' button. Since Stripe uses booking.total_price (178€), user sees one amount in UI but is charged a different amount. Either add service fee to backend booking total OR remove it from UI.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /api/checkout/status returns 500 (see backend critical). payment-success screen cannot confirm payment.

issues: Fixed bottom 'Réserver' footer covers bottom tab bar, making tab navigation inaccessible from detail screen without using hardware back. Consider hiding tab bar on stack screens (already outside tabs) - but the fixed footer currently overlaps the Expo web scroll container.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Non-blocking but should migrate StyleSheet shadow* props.

action_items: FIX /api/checkout/status/{session_id}: wrap emergentintegrations call in try/except and/or ensure StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status routes to the same integrations api_base used for create. Consider reading transaction from local db.payment_transactions as fallback.
DECIDE service fee: either add 10% service fee to backend booking.total_price (so Stripe charges what user sees) OR remove the 'Frais de service' line from /app/frontend/app/booking/[id].tsx summary.
Migrate deprecated shadow* styles to boxShadow in StyleSheets.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/checkout/status does not handle CheckoutError — any Stripe error becomes 500.
Frontend booking summary computes fee client-side but Stripe charge uses server-side total; keep price computation server-side as single source of truth.
server.py is 532 lines — acceptable, but could split models/routers as it grows.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine for JWT bearer auth.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all key flows verified; profile tab not reached due to fixed footer overlap on detail screen, but tabs visible after login)

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_* users; a listing was created and deleted during test. No persistent test data beyond a few test users left behind (prefixed test_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo user demo@locashare.fr/demo1234 OWNS all 8 seeded listings, so demo-login cannot see 'Réserver' — use a fresh registered user to test booking flow. Stripe session IDs from POST /checkout/session currently cannot be retrieved (GET /checkout/status → 500). All backend endpoints except that one are green. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly.
rca_of_issue: RCA for /api/checkout/status 500: In server.py:347-353, StripeCheckout is constructed and .get_checkout_status(session_id) is called. Under the hood emergentintegrations calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve which uses the module-global api_base. The POST endpoint creates sessions through api_base=https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1 (custom proxy), but retrieve defaults to api.stripe.com, so Stripe returns 404 resource_missing. Reproduction: POST /api/checkout/session → get session_id → immediately GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} → 500. Mitigation options: (a) catch CheckoutError and return cached status from db.payment_transactions, (b) ensure stripe.api_base is set consistently on retrieve, (c) upgrade/patch emergentintegrations. Quick patch: wrap call in try/except CheckoutError and return the db transaction status + payment_status as fallback.
